dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. procedures[] is not limited to the six flagship categories; it contains every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the public price/treatment pages reviewed for that clinic.
limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot: prices hidden in booking logins, private PDFs, forms, phone quotations or unindexed pages may not be discoverable.
Rows with no numeric public price are omitted rather than estimated.
Starting, range, package, per-area, per-unit and per-graft semantics are preserved.
Ratings are source-specific and can differ by platform or branch. Keep the stored platform when displaying or comparing ratings.
Prices can change; preserve source_url and checked_at and refresh in the background.
